verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 remains sound. The refusal receipt is bot-authored, run-key-idempotent, windowed by the same proven-human readmission cutoff as attempts, and kept distinct from model-attempt cost, health, void, and approval-staleness surfaces. Both worker-side and claim-side allocation gates consume the shared dispatch-cycle budget. The workflow exports the post-charge refusal exhaustion result with the pre-charge budget result as a skipped-step fallback, so a terminal refusal reaches the existing parked state without breaking ordinary exhausted runs. The added checks exercise the recorder, counter separation, readmission, workflow bindings, and final-state shell path, and include targeted non-crashing mutations for the new YAML seam. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
